chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Every intoxicant among drinks incurs, in its case, the same hadd punishment as is incurred in the case of wine.

key_terms.الْخَمْرِ: wine; here, the standard case for the ruling on intoxicants
key_terms.مُسْكِرٍ: an intoxicating substance that causes drunkenness

ai.seo_question: Does every intoxicating drink carry the same hadd punishment as wine in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that every intoxicating drink carries the same hadd punishment as wine. It establishes that the ruling is based on intoxication in beverages, not restricted only to grape wine.
